camera_basis: Scene-by-scene manual assignment from accepted storyboard and contact-sheet review. Keep movement gentle and continuous within action groups; direct cuts remain. No pan-up/down to protect faces/action and keep framing stable. Endscreen retains subtle motion behind release-stage native elements.
review_limit: Static contact sheets and computed keyframes do not prove full-path motion safety; check all composites/extrema after rendering.
